does_not_prove: decoded-PTS clock binding for live sources
public-internet HLS/RTSP reliability (same code path, unproven endpoints)
character identity on live tracks (still forbidden without the full evidence chain)
proves: tracker producer crash recovery via chained source sessions on a genuine live stream
no track-id identity carryover across the chain boundary
crashed-journal salvage with explicit provenance on every persisted observation
sink-outage resilience with durable outbox and idempotent drain

gate_p0c_process_resume.identity_policy: sessions are distinct source sessions; observation ids are session-scoped; zero id overlap verified across sessions (8 vs 20 observations)
gate_p0c_process_resume.proof: session 1 SIGKILLED mid-run (exit -9, 122 events salvaged, unfinalized); supervisor chained session 2 with previous_session_id == session 1 id; session 2 reconnected to the live stream and finalized 400 events; chain_valid true
gate_p0c_process_resume.salvage: read_journal_lenient recovered the killed journal's valid prefix; salvage replay flags every observation FROM_UNFINALIZED_SESSION_JOURNAL

gate_p0d_outbox.outbox: per-observation sidecar, atomic rewrite per state change
gate_p0d_outbox.proof: replay of session 2 with a dead memory sink absorbed all 20 observations as FAILED_RETRYABLE (no crash, exit 5); --drain against the live daemon converged to 20/20 WRITTEN (attempts=3 each); canonical set matches plan

live_sink_verification.session_scoping: verified live: salvaged docs carry provenance + blocker; finalized docs clean

live_source.clock_mode: declared_frame_offset from stream connect; decoded_pts remains a later gate
live_source.source_hash_mode: uri_only (no file hash for live sources by design)
live_source.uri: http://127.0.0.1:5005 (ffmpeg -re MPEG-TS live loop of Bad Santa from 120s; real-time paced, unseekable, relistens per client)
live_source.why_local: deterministic, contains people, reconnectable; public HLS/RTSP URIs plug into the same supervisor unchanged
